# FeatureBasedGraphEmbedding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of representing idiomatic expressions as graph nodes connected by shared linguistic features, enabling cross-linguistic semantic comparison. Provides a topology-aware representation of semantic relationships that can be mapped onto network-on-chip structures for distributed language processing.
